scope.readScope: Only packet.json, criteria.json, assessment-template.json, each included original brief (all have no attachments), and selected artifacts. No sibling packets, parent assignments/prompts, execution/acceptance logs, generator, skill snapshot or prior outcomes were read.

inspectionMethod.slides: All 8 selected JPGs were individually viewed with view_image at original detail; each is 1920×1080. Native PPTX XML for every slide, each table/text object and all 8 note parts was read. One native chart, its relationship, embedded XLSX sheet and cache/formulas/axis were inspected without extracting or modifying source files.
inspectionMethod.textOnly: Both text-only runs were judged in the stated environment that cannot create or render PPT. All 5 page sections in each storyboard were read in full, including screen text, notes, layout and sources; the full production-handoff/source-data or continuation files were read. No absent visual render was penalized as a failure of the authorized text fallback.
inspectionMethod.hashes: SHA-256 was recalculated from every selected artifact. All 15 match the manifest. Template artifact paths and expected hashes are preserved exactly in assessment.json.

nativeInventory.dataAgreement: Chart cache/formulas/workbook agree on 1月=10000, 2月=12000, 3月=15000件; axis 0–20000, step5000. Satisfaction native table 88/85/80% agrees with the brief.
nativeInventory.calculations: (15000-10000)/10000=50%; 80%-88%=-8 percentage points. 220000/150000/280000 are accurately scaled to 22/15/28 ten-thousand units, without assigning a currency.

observations: Cover and all body pages mark synthetic training data. Source trends are not upgraded into proof of staffing shortage or mechanism.
No invented ROI, saved headcount or payback period is present. Conditional trial validation, complete-cost gates and alternative routes remain explicit.
The visible body page numbers 1–7 follow the unnumbered physical cover; physical slide count remains 8.
limits: No new rendering of the PPTX was performed. Visual assessment applies to the supplied, hash-verified JPGs; their final-file rendering provenance was not independently reconstructed.
No PowerPoint desktop open, edit, save/reopen, slideshow, font-installation or interoperability test was performed. Native XML proves object structure and stored data, not runtime editing behavior.
